title: Compiler size configuration
statement: For a natural-number word size $W$, a size configuration consists of a code layout with $F$ local variables per frame, a list of procedure entry positions, and a dispatcher position $D$, together with execution limits and a natural-number stack size $Q$. The word size must satisfy the compatibility condition relating $W$, the execution limits, $D$, and $Q$, and the dispatcher position must satisfy $2(F+1)\le D$.
hypotheses_covered: Natural number $F$ of local variables per frame
Word-size compatibility condition for the limits, dispatcher position, and stack size
caveat: The supplied statement does not include definitions of the execution limits or the word-size compatibility condition, so their mathematical content cannot be made more explicit.
